# Courier Rules Requirements Quality Checklist: Courier App

**Purpose**: Formal gate on the quality of the requirements for working without signal, carrying out a route, records that arrive after a change, decisions after an exception, and access and privacy, before they are turned into tasks
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · supporting: [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/http-api.md](../contracts/http-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: working without signal and exactly-once · carrying out a route · consistency with features 001 and 002 (lifecycle, custody, routes) · decisions after an exception · access, privacy, and notifications
**Depth**: formal gate · **Reviewer and timing**: project owner, before `/speckit-tasks`

## Working Without Signal — Completeness and Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is "periodically" quantified for sending pending records, consistently with the one-minute freshness target? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK002 Is the data a loaded route must offer without signal defined, rather than "everything needed"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Is the behavior specified when the app opens without signal and no route was ever loaded? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK004 Is it stated that signing in needs signal, and what a courier with an expired session can still do? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Is the order in which records apply defined for a record that arrives after the shipment changed by other means? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Is the clock correction bounded so that a record never appears to happen after it was received? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §EC-03]
- [x] CHK007 Is the outcome defined when the phone cannot save a record at all (not only a photo)? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK008 Is it defined what happens to "Foto pendiente" when the photo never arrives? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK009 Is the reduction of photos expressed with a verifiable target? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 Are the unrecoverable cases (data erased, phone lost) stated with what mitigates them? [Coverage, Spec §EC-05]
- [x] CHK011 Can SC-001 ("exactly once") be verified objectively from stored data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-019]

## Carrying Out a Route

- [x] CHK012 Is the completion rule of a pickup stop consistent with feature 002's definition of progress? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Feature 002 §FR-007]
- [x] CHK013 Is what is captured when an errand is completed specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK014 Are the limits of the received-by name defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 Is it stated at which records money is collected and at which it is not? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK016 Are amount limits and the confirmation threshold consistent with feature 001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Feature 001 §FR-037]
- [x] CHK017 Is it clear for which shipments and at what moment a disbursement can be recorded? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK018 Is the effect of a second problem report on the same shipment defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK019 Are shortcuts defined for stops without a phone number or without a recipient? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK020 Is it specified how a courier sees packages they hold that are on no route? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK021 Are the constitution's courier-app rules (taps, target size, devices, contrast) stated as requirements of this feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038, Constitution VII]

## Records That Arrive After a Change — Consistency with Features 001 and 002

- [x] CHK022 Is the pickup of a shipment that sits on a route in preparation defined, consistently with feature 002's rule that picked-up shipments cannot be there? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Feature 002 §EC-15]
- [x] CHK023 Do FR-025 and FR-026 together cover every record kind and every shipment status, without overlap? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK024 Is the handling of a disbursement for a shipment no longer on the courier's route stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK025 Is it defined who clears "Por revisar", with what, and what clearing changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK026 Is the other courier informed when their stop disappears because the first courier's record applied? [Coverage, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK027 Are the lifecycle transitions listed in the spec the same as in the shared lifecycle table of feature 001? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Feature 001 data model]
- [x] CHK028 Does SC-007 include the office as a holder, consistently with the custody definition? [Consistency, Spec §SC-007, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK029 Is the rule for a record repeated from a second phone distinguishable from a record "No aplicado"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, §EC-08]

## Decisions After an Exception

- [x] CHK030 Is the route proposed for a new attempt defined, and which routes may be chosen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK031 Is the place of the return stop defined for every shipment kind, including reverse pickups? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK032 Is it stated whether a decision can be changed before it is carried out? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK033 Are the shipments for which "Recibido en oficina" can be recorded, and its precondition, stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041]
- [x] CHK034 Is what a reverted record returns the shipment to defined for each kind (delivery, exception, return)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-035, Data model §Lifecycle]
- [x] CHK035 Is it stated which record can be reverted and what happens to its collection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK036 Is "delivery attempt" defined so that the first-attempt rate is computable, including reverted records? [Measurability, Spec §FR-032, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK037 Is the courier to whom a record on behalf is attributed defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK038 Is the open business question (who pays a failed attempt) isolated so that it does not block this feature? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Access, Privacy, and Notifications

- [x] CHK039 Is it specified what stays on the phone after sign-out, after a route finishes, and after access is withdrawn? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK040 Is photo retention stated as a requirement with what the user sees afterwards? [Gap, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK041 Is the visibility of photos and of the history defined for each role? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036, §FR-039]
- [x] CHK042 Is the set of changes that produce a notice complete with respect to the actions of features 002 and 003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK043 Is the scope of "Entendido" (one notice or all shown) unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK044 Is it stated that a notification that cannot be delivered never affects the dispatcher's action, and what remains the reference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK045 Are "last synchronization" and "acknowledged" on the dispatch board defined precisely enough to be tested? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033]

## Acceptance Criteria and Traceability

- [x] CHK046 Does every edge case map to a functional requirement that states its rule? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK047 Are acceptance scenarios defined for session expiry during a route and for a first open without signal? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK048 Are SC-005 and SC-008 expressed so that they can be checked during the pilot? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §SC-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline

## Review record

- **2026-09-30**: all 48 items evaluated by the assistant at the reviewer's explicit request
  and marked satisfied after revising the spec. Eleven were satisfied as written (CHK010,
  CHK011, CHK012, CHK026–CHK029, CHK038, CHK044, CHK046, CHK048); the other 37 required a
  change, from a one-phrase precision to a new rule.
- The spec keeps 41 functional requirements; FR-003–FR-005, FR-008, FR-009, FR-011, FR-012,
  FR-014, FR-016, FR-018–FR-020, FR-022, FR-023, FR-025–FR-027, FR-029, FR-032–FR-036,
  FR-038, FR-039, and FR-041 were tightened, and User Story 2 gained two scenarios.
- Rules decided by the assistant, open to the reviewer's change:
  - a photo that has not arrived 24 hours after its record counts as missing (CHK008);
  - collected totals and disbursements above COP 2,000,000 ask for confirmation (CHK016);
  - a pickup recorded for a shipment on a route in preparation takes it off that route
    (CHK022);
  - a return stop is at the place where the shipment was picked up; for a reverse pickup,
    the recipient's address (CHK031);
  - a return decided and not completed can be changed to a new attempt (CHK032);
  - only the latest delivery, exception, or return of a shipment can be reverted; reverting
    a return goes back to "Novedad" with the return pending (CHK034, CHK035);
  - "Entendido" acknowledges all the notices shown (CHK043);
  - when access is withdrawn, the phone removes the route data and keeps the list of
    pending records (CHK039).
- The data model and the contract were aligned with these rules.
